notes: annual_reports/PRIMEBANK archive (2010-2025, 15 years) was already text-extracted by a parallel session working on this project. Unlike most other banks researched, Prime Bank's annual reports do not contain a single clean multi-year 'Financial Highlights' table for most years; data for 2016-2025 was instead assembled from the 2021 report's unusually complete 'Key Performance Analysis - Tabular Presentation' (covering 2016-2021) and the 2025 report's 'Financial Trend' (covering 2020-2025), each cross-validated against individual years' own audited Balance Sheets, which caught and corrected two small (~0.1-0.3%) discrepancies in the retrospective tables for FY2016-2017. FY2014-2015 data is comparatively thin (only a partial field set located, from a 2-year comparative table in the 2015 report), and FY2011-2013 could not be located at all within the time available. Only Q4/year-end (audited) data was extracted in that pass; Q1/Q2/Q3 unaudited interim data was researched in a later session (see the Q1/Q3 and Q2 source entries below) -- primebank.com.bd's own quarterly/half-yearly archive turned out to be a clean, unblocked, essentially complete 2010-2025 series (48 filings), giving this bank one of the longest and most complete quarterly time series in the whole dataset, spanning further back (to 2010) than its own Q4/annual series (which starts 2014).

sources.source_document: primebank-unaudited-{q1,h1,q3}-<year>.txt (one file per period, native-text PDFs)
sources.note: Found primebank.com.bd's own quarterly/half-yearly disclosure archive at https://www.primebank.com.bd/quarterly-half-yearly-reports (confirmed working, not WAF-blocked): 48 filings spanning 2010-2025 (Q1/Half-Yearly/Q3 every year) plus 2 more for 2026 (Q1, H1), matching the ~50-PDF estimate exactly. These periods' PDFs were genuine text-layer (non-scanned) and extracted cleanly with pdftotext -layout. Each document contains a Consolidated section followed by a Solo (Bank-only) section for both Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss; SOLO is used throughout per project convention. Q3 filings from 2016-2020 and ALL H1 filings show a 4-column P&L (cumulative + discrete-quarter, each with a comparative); the cumulative pair (first two columns) was used -- an initial parser pass mistakenly extracted the discrete-quarter columns for these, caught by re-deriving the Q2/Q3-2024 figures and cross-checking against the annual report's own embedded 'Quarterly Performance' table (see 2024 sources), then fixed and re-validated against every period. nav_per_share genuinely not disclosed in 2012, 2014, 2016, 2017, and the 2018 Q1 filing specifically (present from 2018 H1 onward) -- left null rather than fabricated. 2022 H1's 'borrowings' balance-sheet row lost its label text during extraction (note ref '12a' and the two amounts survived); position plus an exact liabilities-sum reconciliation (borrowings+deposits+other_liabilities=total_liabilities) confirms the value with high confidence.

These filings' PDFs were image-based (scanned), not text-layer -- 2010-2013 used a dense single-'poster'-page format (2011 H1 was an unusual 25MB/20400px-tall single page, sliced into vertical segments to read), 2015 Q1/Q3 and 2014 Q1/Q3 used an 8-page scanned format, 2025 Q3 was unexpectedly a 7.6MB scanned PDF despite every neighboring quarter being a normal ~0.8MB text PDF. Figures were read directly off high-resolution (150-300 DPI) page renders of the original documents -- NOT trusted from raw OCR text, which was demonstrably unreliable on a first pass (e.g. digit transpositions found and corrected in 2012 Q1 and 2013 Q3 total_liabilities via the balance-sheet identity check; several 2011 Q3/2012 Q3/2013 Q3 P&L figures were mis-transcribed on an initial read and had to be re-verified against a zoomed crop). Every period's balance-sheet identity (assets=liabilities+equity) and P&L arithmetic chain (opincome-opexpense=opprofit; opprofit-provision=PBT; PBT-tax=PAT) reconciles exactly. A best-effort Tesseract OCR transcript of the same pages is kept in annual_reports/PRIMEBANK/ as *-ocr.txt for reference/future re-verification, but is not itself the source of the JSON figures. 2010 Q1 and Q3 are CONSOLIDATED-ONLY (this vintage's Q1/Q3 disclosure format had no separate Solo section at all, unlike its own H1 filing which did); 2013 Q1 is also CONSOLIDATED-ONLY (used an older thin single-page template unlike the taller dual-section format its own Q3 filing used that same year) -- both explicitly flagged per project convention. All other periods in this group are Solo.

sources.period: 2013 H1 (unaudited interim, text extraction with cleanup)
sources.note: Text-layer PDF, but pdftotext output had a font-kerning glitch inserting spurious spaces inside words (e.g. 'B alance' for 'Balance', 'T otal' for 'Total') that broke section-header detection; fixed with a targeted regex join and re-extracted from the cleaned text (kept as the retained .txt, no OCR needed). Genuine loss half-year, Solo net loss -679,326,543 (EPS -0.66), driven by a large specific loan-loss provision spike; the loss trajectory cross-validates exactly across three independent documents' comparative columns (this filing, 2014 Q1's Jan-Mar'13 comparative, and 2014 Q3's Jan-Sep'13 comparative all agree to within BDT 1).

All 50 PDFs in the archive (2010-2025 x 3 + 2026 Q1/H1) were downloaded and inspected; 2026 H1 was found to also be a scanned/image PDF (8.1MB) and was NOT processed (out of the requested 2010-2025 scope; a genuine gap, not a fabrication) -- left as a future-session item if 2026 quarterly coverage is ever prioritized. Every PDF was deleted after extraction per project policy; only structured JSON + retained source .txt remain.
